file: registry/emotion_wavlm_ft_full.pt (361 MB, local only: too big for git, share through a Release or DVC)
task: speech emotion recognition, 6 classes (anger, disgust, fear, happy, neutral, sad)
model: WavLM base+ fine-tuned (CNN front end frozen, transformer trained, learned weighting of all 13 layers, small head)
augmentation: gain, speed/pitch 0.9-1.1x, telephone band limit, white noise 15-35 dB
data: CREMA-D + RAVDESS speech, actor-wise split identical to the notebook (seed 42), 5,987 train / 1,312 val / 1,198 test clips
limits: Acted speech only. The test noise is white noise, the same kind used in training augmentation, so real call noise (babble, hum, codecs) may be harder. Few test actors: clean-accuracy differences of 2-3 points are within noise.
